name: lahlah-video-mcp
description: MCP server that lets Claude drive the LahLah Video editor: open Claude's Higgsfield hand-off, run edit commands, export for TikTok or YouTube.
author: Dr Alfred Ang, Tertiary Infotech Academy

scripts.build:
esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('bundle/server',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('dist/server.js','bundle/server/index.js');fs.copyFileSync('../docs/icon.png','bundle/icon.png')" && mcpb pack bundle ../dist-release/lahlah-video.mcpb
